trait_description.value: The dragon recharges their Breath Weapon whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

(acid)

The brine dragon's body is encrusted with salty, acidic crystals.

When a target takes damage from one of the dragon's melee Strikes, it must succeed at a DC 38 Fortitude Save or be stunned 1 (stunned 3 on a critical failure). The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

action_description.value: (acid, magical, reach 20 feet) 3d10+17 piercing plus 5d4 acid

(acid, evocation, primal)

The dragon breathes a spray of acidic salt water that deals 18d6 acid damage in a 120-foot line (DC 38 basic Reflex save). They can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

(attack)

The dragon tries to capsize an adjacent aquatic vessel of their size or smaller. They must succeed at an Athletics check with a DC of 35 (reduced by 5 for each size smaller the vessel is than the dragon) or the pilot's Sailing Lore DC, whichever is higher.
The dragon makes a jaws Strike. On a hit, the target takes 6d6 persistent acid damage, and is sickened 3 from the pain of salt and brine in its wounds.
The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one wing Strike in any order.

Trigger: A creature the brine dragon observes within 30 feet uses a concentrate action

The dragon spits a glob of caustic salt water at the creature. The creature takes 7d6 acid damage (DC 36 basic Reflex save). On a failure, the concentrate action is disrupted.

description.value:
You call forth a powerful blast of pressurized water that bludgeons the target and knocks it back. Make a ranged spell attack roll.

Critical Success: The target takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked back 10 feet.
Success: The target takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked back 5 feet.
You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become concealed, and all creatures outside the mist become concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.

By imposing your will upon the water, you can raise or lower the level of water in the chosen area by 10 feet. Creatures that have the water and that are in the area when you Cast the Spell must attempt a Fortitude save, with the effects of the of slow spell.

You afflict the target with the curse of the roiling, unforgiving sea. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success: The target is unaffected.
Success: The target becomes sickened 1. Reducing its sickened condition to 0 ends the curse.
Failure: The target becomes sickened 1 and can't reduce its sickened condition below 1 while the curse remains. The curse can be lifted by remove curse or similar magic. Whenever the target is sickened and on the water at least a mile from shore, it is also slowed 1.
Critical Failure: As failure, but the target becomes sickened 2.

A swirling torrent of water manifests along a straight line, battering those that are its path and possibly pushing them away from you. The torrent deals 8d6 bludgeoning damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic Fortitude save. Creatures that fail the save are also knocked back 5 feet (10 feet on a critical failure).
